name: Shoukansha
source:
A long time has passed since the great collapse originating from the fighting inside the royal family. The art of summoning that caused so much confusion on the continent has disappeared from the memory of people. But the unrest still goes on exhausting people. These times got the name of Times of Chaos. 

The story starts as Nash the adventurer travels in the forest. He meets fairy girl who sets to accompany him and many other girls on the way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
王族内斗引发“大崩坏”后，漫长岁月已经流逝。曾令整片大陆陷入混乱的召唤术，也从人们记忆中消失。然而，动荡依然持续，百姓早已疲惫不堪。这个时代因此得名“混沌纪元”。

故事始于冒险者纳什穿越森林的旅程。他在那里遇见一名妖精少女，对方决定与他同行。一路上，他还会邂逅许多其他女孩。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vndb-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
